en.title: D
en.summary: The letter D is a consonant in the Romanian alphabet.

sections.title: Letter sound
paragraphs: This letter is called /d/. It makes the sound /d/, like in the word (dorință) /dor/, which means longing. The letter always makes one single sound.

sections.title: Mouth movements
paragraphs: Place the tip of your tongue against the back of your top front teeth. Block the air completely. Then release your tongue as you vibrate your vocal cords. Touch your throat to feel that buzzing vibration.

sections.title: Reading rules
paragraphs: In all standard positions, this letter makes the sound /d/. You hear it clearly in the word (cald) /kald/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not place your tongue behind the teeth on the upper gum like in English door. Keep the tip firmly against the back of your top front teeth instead.
